thread:
maria: Heads-up — starting a small deprecation wave for older /v1 endpoints next Tue. Plan is nonblocking: client opt-in header, 6-week soft window, gateway shim that routes when header missing. Details below.

nick: quick q — why nonblocking? are we allowing traffic to keep flowing without redirects?

maria: want to avoid breaking enterprise integrations. goal: prefer new schema but not fail requests. We return an 'Deprecation' response-header and telemetry. After 6 weeks we'll flip stricter errors for tenants opted-in to enforcement.

devon: can you share example header? will SDKs auto-add?

maria: example:

```
X-Redwood-Compat-Mode: accept-v2 | opt-in-v2 | enforce-v2
```

SDKs will default to accept-v2; opt-in needed to get new behavior. We'll push SDK patches next week.

sarah: how will gateway shim detect client capabilities? header only or body sniff?

maria: primary is header. fallback: probe by tenant metadata and user agent. We'll also support a streaming probe endpoint for client capabilities.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled canary for gateway shim at 2023-10-12T02:00:00Z :rocket:

nick: telemetry—what events? prefer coarse-grained to avoid PII.

maria: agreed. we'll emit counts: total requests, mapped_to_v2, fallback_to_v1, and error_rates per-tenant. no payloads. tag metrics with 'dep_wave_2023q4'.

tim: rollback plan?

maria: instant feature-flag rollback on gateway + fallback to explicit shim in edge; also CDN header strip if needed. Ops runbook updated.

devon: any SLA impact during canary?

maria: minimal expected. we'll route small percent initially and monitor latency and 5xx; auto-stop if >2x baseline 95p latency or >0.5% 5xx.

sarah: sounds good. i'll add tenant opt-out list and notify account execs.

maria: thanks — I'll post RFC follow-up and a checklist. If no objections, we'll start toggling canaries Mon morning.

nick: :thumbsup:

maria: one more note — we will add a grace header for proxies: `X-Compat-Warn: true` if we detect backend mapping. Intended for partners.
